description: SEC earnings quality score — Earnings-quality check for any US-listed company from its 10-K XBRL data: cash conversion (operating cash flow / net income), Sloan accrual ratio, free-cash-flow conversion and margin, capex vs depreciation, stock comp as a share of cash flow, receivables and inventory growth vs revenue. Returns a 0-100 score, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW quality, red flags and strengths for the last 4 fiscal years. ticker= or cik=. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_earnings_quality
